I couldn't find anything that cleaned my hair and didn't irritate my scalp HORRIBLY or dry my hair out, except for rye flour and it's really messy.  This stuff is great. I tried this in the pear scent and it got rid of the flakes after several baths. His scalp is moisturized and his hair is so soft and shiny. The scent is AMAZING and a little goes a long way. I was only about halfway done with the bottle, but couldn't resist buying another one. I got the tropical scent and love it just as much as the pear. They are both so

I have tried a lot of different shampoos over the years. For an unscented, natural style product, this is my current favorite. Yes, other products have done some things better, but I usually have one or two complaints. This works for me.

We have tried many brands of baby wash/shampoo over the last 2 years and have found this one to be the best by far.  We get the Tropical Baby scent, and it smells SO good....just enough hint of coconut. But, the best part about this wash is that it's all-natural.  It does not irritate my baby's sensitive skin, and I don't have to worry that I'm bathing her in chemicals like with other brands. The only thing to remember is there is not an anesthetic in this, so be sure not to get it in your baby'

Ok so first off I don't like the smell of baby powder so now that I have a baby (supa cute 4month boy) I look everywhere for products that smell more fresh or fruity.  Also since my husband is allergic to everything my lil man is allergic is close to everything... Most brands give him bumps or make him itchy.  This shampoo is very gentle, a lil goes a long way and it it smells great (tropical). I think I'll also try the pear to see which I like best.  The vendor is great too, very nice and fast

Love the shampoo.  Especially the bubble gum scent & Tropical scent. The vanilla scent is too sweet smelling for me.  The shampoo is gentle on your hair & smells wonderful.  I color my hair and it does not strip my color out. My hair is in the best condition it has ever been since I switched to this shampoo 6 months ago. Also use as a body wash. Love love love it! Please make the bubble gum scent available year around as it is my favorite.

This is the only shampoo that I will ever use for my children from now on! Smooth, soft hair and it smells wonderful (tropical). Not to mention, my daughter has the kind of hair that collects fuzz - it washes out dirt magnificently! ANDDDDD strangely her hair hasn't collected any fuzz since using this shampoo. Coincidence? No complaints there! I mean, she was a "crawling/walking" vacuum lol so I'm thankful

reviews.t: Smells heavenly and works amazingly well.
reviews.x: I cannot believe how amazing this shampoo smells and works.  I use it on both of my kids who have very different hair and it is perfect for both naturally perfect wavy hair and super curly frizzy hair.  The smell is out of this world too and lasts for days.  Usually when my son's head gets sweaty he just stinks but since using this shampoo his hair smells really good after sweating.

reviews.t: We absolutely love this baby shampoo
reviews.x: We absolutely love this baby shampoo. My 3 year old son has very sensitive skin and other shampoo brands (which apparently contain harmful ingredients) caused skin problems for him. This shampoo is super gentle, doubles as a body wash, and smells AMAZING. My son smells like a pina colada! Absolutely worth the higher price tag when you get this many pluses.

This is the best shampoo! I have been looking for a shampoo without parabens, etc.. and found this on Amazon & thought I would give it a try & I love it! It smells wonderful and even though it is Baby Shampoo I use it and my hair looks and smells great. I will be ordering more.

After learning about what is in J&J shampoo I decided to look elsewhere and found this and love it for my little girls hair. I notice her scalp is cleaner and it was hard giving up the J&J shampoo only because of the smell but I love this shampoo's smell too! Worth the switch.

i tried their tropical baby(for myself), and am very satisfied with the product. Smells just right and it makes me feel great knowing that the product is free of harmful chemicals. I will keep using this product for myself and my (future) babies.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the shampoo for being gentle and non-irritating, especially for sensitive scalps and babies.
Many reviewers love the scents, particularly the tropical scent, and find them pleasant.
Several reviewers report that the shampoo leaves hair soft, shiny, and healthy.
A few reviewers mention issues with the packaging, such as flimsy flip tops, or with the product not lathering well.
One reviewer reports that the product caused a rash on their nephew, though they still gave five stars for customer service.
